question: which workflow in embabel/embabel-agent fails most often
cypher:
MATCH (r:GitHubRepository {full_name: 'embabel/embabel-agent'})-[:HAS_RUN_HISTORY]->(run:WorkflowRun)
WHERE run.status = 'completed'
WITH run.name AS workflow, count(run) AS runs, sum(CASE WHEN run.conclusion = 'failure' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failures
WHERE runs > 0
RETURN workflow, runs, failures, toFloat(failures) / runs AS failureRate
ORDER BY failureRate DESC, failures DESC LIMIT 1
